senses.gloss: स-बल- + अनुग स-बल- + अनुग, adj. with (his) army and followers, Chr. 54, 16.
शब्द- + ग्रह शब्द- + ग्रह, m. 1. The ear. 2. Catching sound.
स-ब्रह्मचर्य स-ब्रह्मचर्य, n. studying together.
शब्दादि- + धर्मन् शब्दादि- + धर्मन्, i. e. शब्द-आदि-, n. quality of sound, etc., Bhāg. P. 3, 32, 28.
स- + बल स- + बल, adj. 1. powerful, strong, Pañc. i. d. 267. 2. with (his) army, Chr. 54, 16.
शबल शबल = शवल, q. cf.

स-बलि स-बलि,
 I. adj. endowed with (royal) revenues, Pañc. 130, 17.
 II. m. evening twilight.
स- + बाध स- + बाध, adj. 1. painful. 2. oppressive.
शब्द- + ब्रह्मन् शब्द- + ब्रह्मन्, n. holy writ, Veda, Utt. Rāmac. 37, 3; cf. 36, 11.
शब्द- + मात्र शब्द- + मात्र, n. mere sound, sound only, Pañc. 20, 20.
स-बहु-मान + म् स-बहु-मान + म्, adv. with great reverence, Pañc. 130, 16.
स-बाल- + वृद्ध स-बाल- + वृद्ध, adj. with children and old men.

शब्द- + वेधिन् शब्द- + वेधिन्,
 I. adj. an archer who is able to hit an object not seen but only heard, Rām. 2, 63, 10; ˚धित्व, n. its abstract, Rām. 1, 28, 22.
 II. m. a name of Arjuna.

शब्द् शब्द्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from शब्द), शब्दय and शब्दापय, Par.
 1. To sound, Śiś. 11, 47; to bray, Pañc. 224, 9.
 2. To call, MBh. 3, 14400.
 3. To address, Rām. 2, 59, 7 (शब्दापय).
 --Ptcple. pf. pass. शब्दित, n. Braying (of an ass), Pañc. 249, 6.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, To declare, Man. 6, 82.
 --With सम् सम्, To say, MBh. 1, 3215.

शब्द शब्द, i. e. शप्-द (vb. दा), m.
 1. Sound, Pañc. 129, 15; noise, Pañc. 123, 24.
 2. A word, Vikr. d. 1.
 3. Grammar, Pañc. 4, 17; Daśak. in Chr. 180, 8.
 --Comp.

शाब्द शाब्द, i. e. शब्द + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Sonorous, sounding.
 2. Relating to or derived from words, Bhāṣāp. 80.
 3. Nominal.
 II. f. दि, Sarasvatī.
शब्दज शब्द-ज, adj. Produced by words, by verbal communication, Bhāṣāp. 51.

शब्दन शब्द् + अन,
 I. adj. Sounding, sonorous.
 II. n. Uttering sounds.
शब्दाय शब्दाय, a denomin. [] derived from शब्द with य, Ātm. To sound, to cry, Pañc. 254, 21; to bray, Pañc. 249, 5.

शाब्दिक शाब्दिक, i. e. शब्द + इक,
 I. adj. Relating to sounds or words.
 II. m. A grammarian.
शब्द- + शास्त्र शब्द- + शास्त्र, n. rules of grammar, [] Pañc. 4, 17.
सबाध् स-बाध्, adj. Striking with fear, Chr. 290, 8 = Rigv. i. 64, 8.
